lab: Lab 01 v0.2 — synthetic multi-plane network assurance
disclaimer: All observations are synthetic. This code was NOT used in any employer investigation.

timeline_assessment.limitation: The SYN timestamps/tuples are consistent across two synthetic observation planes. Clock synchronization, retransmission identity, complete transit, application owner and a general root cause are NOT established.

correlations.limitation: Matching packet and active translation support this sampled flow only. Syslog has no ports; application identity, full transit and overall cause are NOT proven.

timeline_assessment.limitation: A unique NAT candidate and endpoint observation are prerequisites.

correlations.limitation: Multiple different inside sockets share the observed translated tuple in this time window.

warnings: A 106021 record lacks Layer 4 ports and cannot uniquely identify a PAT translation.
Compatible SYN timing is not proof of application identity, full packet transit, a unique flow, or causality.
Timing comparison assumes reasonably aligned clocks; ISO offsets are normalized, but unknown clock skew is not estimated.
The illustrative 1/2/4/8-second backoff is not a universal TCP retransmission timing guarantee.
